newsitem.title: USA: Medical Alliance says option exercised.
newsitem.headline: Medical Alliance says option exercised.

text.p: Medical Alliance Inc said Monday that the 300,000 share over-allotment option has been exercised by Bear Stearns & Co Inc.
Medical Alliance's initial public offering of 2,000,000 shares of common stock at $11.00 per share occurred on October 11.
Bear Stearns & Co Inc lead managed the offering with Equitable Securities Corp serving as co-manager.
Medical Alliance Inc is a leading provider of services to create temporary surgical sites in the physician office, serving about 2,500 physicians in 40 states and Canada.
